notices.support: Each agreement shall contain the following statement appearing on the front page thereof in immediate proximity to the space reserved for the buyer's signature and in boldface type of a minimum size of ten points
notices.start: You may cancel this agreement if it has been signed by a party
notices.end: for an explanation of this right.
notices.quote_note: none: the statement is not in quotation marks; it follows the lead-in 'the following statement ... :' and consists of the paragraph beginning 'You may cancel this agreement' plus the next one-line paragraph 'See the attached notice of cancellation form for an explanation of this right.'
notices.boundary_unsure: The statement has no closing marker. It is cut as the two paragraphs after the lead-in, ending at 'explanation of this right.'; the next paragraph (the attached duplicate form lead-in) begins a different requirement. The statute lets FTC forms be substituted. Statute says 'in excess of twenty-five dollars'; 940 CMR 3.01 says $25 or more; printed for any job sold at the customer's home.

changes.support: H. The seller or lessor shall inform the buyer orally, at the time he signs the agreement, of his right to cancel and shall not misrepresent in any manner such right.
the agreement itself is "in the same language as that principally used in the oral sales presentation"

J. A seller of services shall not commence such service during the three business day cancellation period, and the buyer shall not be responsible for the value of work performed during such period, in the event of cancellation.

changes.new: HIC registration (owner-occupied 1 to 4 units). Not required of a contractor who works exclusively in landscaping; interior painting or wall covering; finished floor covering; fencing or freestanding masonry walls; above-ground swimming pools; shutter or awning installation; ground level patios; or asphalt and driveway installation and maintenance (c. 142A s. 14); construction supervisor license separately
changes.support: any contractor or subcontractor who works exclusively in any of the following home improvement areas: landscaping; interior painting or wall covering; or finished floor covering, including but not limited to carpeting, vinyl floor covering, tile; or fencing or freestanding masonry walls; or above-ground swimming pools; or shutter or awning installation; or ground level patios; or asphalt and driveway installation and maintenance.

changes.new: Recurring charges: written disclosure before purchase, cancellation through the same medium, written reminder 5 to 30 calendar days before the cancel date for terms over 31 days; all-in total price disclosure
changes.support: (4) For any Negative Option Feature exceeding 31 days, failing to provide the consumer written notice within no more than 30 and no fewer than five calendar days prior to the date upon which the consumer must cancel

changes.new: OFFICIAL text read (Secretary of the Commonwealth PDF); applies to acts as of September 2, 2025; 31 days or less has its own notice rule (38.05(6))
changes.support: 940 CMR 38.00 shall apply to acts committed or practices in force as of September 2, 2025.

unsure: MA-142A-notices: the statute gives no wording for the registration, cancellation, warranty, lien and permit notices; the regulation only names the office the registration notice must point to.

MA-cancel: the statute lets the FTC form be substituted for the state form, so whether the state statement belongs in the contract at all is open; the statute says in excess of $25 and 940 CMR 3.01 says $25 or more.
The deposit cap is the greater of one-third or special-order material cost; the structured deposit fields were left empty because one fraction alone would misstate the rule.

MA-blank-spaces: the statute's lower-case sentence is the one cut; if capitals are wanted the regulation's block 2 holds 'DO NOT SIGN THIS CONTRACT IF THERE ARE ANY BLANK SPACES.' (201 CMR 18.05(2)(a)8.d).
MA-adr-clause: optional model clause stored on file only, never printed; whether the Owner/Contractor line and the NOTICE sentence are part of the model language is a judgement (see boundary_unsure).
